Directions(Q.1-2 ): Answer the questions based on the information given below.  
Yash started his journey from his saloon to his house. He walks 15m towards in north direction  
and stops at Point C. From there, he takes two consecutive right turns of 15m each and stops at  
Point D. From there, he takes two consecutive left turns of 12m each and stops at Point A. From  
there, he walks 18m to his right and stops at Point B. Yash’s house is in south of Point B and  
east of Point D.  
1. What is the shortest distance between Yash’s Saloon and Yash’s house?  
1) 55m  
2) 47m  
3) 45m  
4) 57m  
5) None of the above  
Ans: 3  
Shortest distance between Yash’s Saloon and Yash’s house = 18 + 12 + 15 = 45 m.  
2. Point C is in which direction with respect of Point B?  
1) West  
2) SouthWest  
3) NorthWest  
4) North-East  
Direction Distance Assignment - 1  
5) None of the above  
Ans: 3
